liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Me And Bobby McGee** (1 other source): A dropout occurs at 1:55 in Bobby McGee [3]
- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Reviewer heard Casey Jones the night they attended, but it's absent from this setlist; no recording of that show is known [11]
- Reviewer notes the music doesn't match the setlist and claims this date has the first Brown Eyed Women [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-08-23.sbd.miller.125886.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 194 min; rated 3.85/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader notes some vocal distortion, with seamless disc changes [1]
- **gd1971-08-23.165863.partial.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 119 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd71-08-23.aud.cotsman.9759.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 118 min; rated 2/5 by 10 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it the worst recording they've heard, like a cheap tape player with a built-in microphone; Reviewer finds this audience recording poor-sounding, but says the music rocks on Dick's Picks 35; Poor sound quality nearly ruins it, though the reviewer wasn't much bothered by the cheap-sounding recording [3][5][8][10][12]
- **gd1971-08-23.165864.partial.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 21 songs; 119 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended the previous night's show, sitting in an opera box on the left side with their brother [11]
- Reviewer notes 1971 was a year of trying out new material like Bird Song, Deal, Playin', and Wharf Rat [16]
- Reviewer recommends a Folsom Field 9/3/72 soundboard as another good recording, having attended that show too [11]
- All that was salvageable from the 8/24 show was released on Dick's Picks 35 [13]
- Reviewer says the Cryptical into Uncle John suite rivals the more famous Hollywood Bowl version [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-08-23.sbd.miller.125886.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> CD [1]. Also: Deadlists says audience tapes were made by Stephen Wade, who taped only the first show, so the date is 8/23, not 8/24; Reel flips cut the start of Casey Jones, the end of Me And My Uncle, and the Not Fade Away jam [1][13]
- **gd1971-08-23.165863.partial.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac16**: taped by from the collection of Doug Lamarre.; transferred by Matt Vernon, SirMick; source: Audio Cassette (3rd gen) [2]. Also: Dwight Holmes says Stephen Wade made the circulating audience tapes, taping only the first show, so it's 8/23 not 8/24 [2]
- **gd71-08-23.aud.cotsman.9759.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon, Raoul Duke, JCotsman; source: Audience [3]. Also: Most cuts come from stopping the reel to save time and batteries, and are very minor [3]
- **gd1971-08-23.165864.partial.aud.lamarre.vernon.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Unknown from the collection of Doug Lamarre.; transferred by Matt Vernon, SirMick; source: Audio Cassette (3rd gen) from the collection of Doug Lamarre. [4]
